office_does: A Benton County District Court judge, elected countywide for four years, hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor cases, traffic and other infractions, small claims, anti-harassment matters and civil cases up to $100,000.
race_blurb: Judge Jennifer (Lampson) Azure, appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, is the only candidate. She submitted no statement to the voters' guide.

candidates.summary: Benton County District Court judge since her 2021 appointment (elected 2022); former Franklin County and city prosecutor and criminal-defense attorney; submitted no voters'-guide statement. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Judge in Position 5 since her 2021 appointment; 99.0% as the only named candidate in 2022 [S2][S3]
Former Franklin County and city prosecutor, then nearly ten years in private criminal-defense, civil and juvenile practice [S2]
Submitted no statement to the 2026 voters' guide [S1]
